candidates.tagline: Your €80,000 BMW plays a Spider-Man ad the moment you start it
candidates.story: BMW pushed a Spider-Man: Brand New Day promotional banner to 70+ countries via an over-the-air software update in late July 2026, appearing on iDrive screens the instant drivers started their cars — despite BMW's own SVP declaring in 2023 that 'to sell the screen for a commercial, I don't see it; it's a private space.'
candidates.why_funny: BMW spent years insisting your car dashboard was a sacred private space, then used that sacred private space to play a Sony movie trailer at 7am in your own driveway.
candidates.alt: A BMW iDrive touchscreen showing a Spider-Man: Brand New Day promotional banner that appeared automatically at car startup across more than 70 markets worldwide via over-the-air update

candidates.tagline: Musk's AI Wikipedia quietly died in April — 6.7 million readers weren't told
candidates.story: xAI launched Grokipedia in October 2025 as an AI-powered Wikipedia rival that grew to 6 million articles; it stopped updating entirely on April 24, 2026, leaving 13,002 user edits stuck 'in review' for three months — while Musk never mentioned it after February and 6.7 million monthly visitors kept reading its frozen, unmoderated content without any warning.
candidates.why_funny: The AI encyclopedia that promised to never go out of date became more out of date than the Encyclopaedia Britannica volumes gathering dust in your parents' garage — and it didn't even tell anyone.
candidates.alt: The Grokipedia homepage interface — a Wikipedia-style AI-generated encyclopedia launched by Elon Musk's xAI in 2025 — as it appeared before its April 2026 editorial freeze
